title: Among non-carcinogenic molecules that contain either iodine or sulfur atoms
question: Among non-carcinogenic molecules that contain either iodine or sulfur atoms involved in single bonds, which element (iodine or sulfur) appears more frequently?

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_003" AS element
FROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1."XCL_002" = T2."XCL_010"
INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T1."XCL_002" = T3."XCL_005"
WHERE T2."XCL_011" = '-'
  AND T3."XCL_006" = '-'
  AND T1."XCL_003" IN ('i', 's')
GROUP BY T1."XCL_003"
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT T1."XCL_001") DESC
LIMIT 1
